claims.claim: A restored effect_pending call whose persisted call policy is "safe" and whose tool declares replay "safe" is replayed when the run is not cancelled; the blanket never-replay guard is removed.
The stale progress checkpoint is cleared (deleted and its persisted args materialized) before the tool is re-invoked, so the replay never reads the old checkpoint.
The replayed invocation's resulting outcome is published only after the invocation completes, via the completion continuation.

Unsafe ("never") call policies, missing tools, tools without a replay declaration, and cancelled runs keep the conditional restriction: the checkpoint is read and an interrupted outcome with the interruption marker is published instead of replaying.

validation.notes: Ran from the workspace root with Node v24.14.0 and exited 0. The regression loads the real recoverToolInvocation from packages/agent/src/harness/runtime/drive/tools.ts through .prale-eval/subject.mjs (checkpoint clear/read, tool invocation and outcome publication are the only fakes) and asserts, not prints, the contract: (1) a safe/safe call that is not cancelled produces exactly ['clear','invoke','effect-complete','publish'], with the clear strictly before the invocation and the publication strictly after the invocation completes, the published outcome being the tool result (isError false, text 'effect-result', recovery-tagged) carrying the persisted args and no interruption marker, and the old checkpoint never read; (2) an unsafe call policy, a tool declaring 'never', an absent tool, a tool with no replay declaration, a cancelled safe/safe run and a cancelled unsafe run all keep the conditional restriction, each producing ['read','publish'] with an isError interruption result that retains the durable checkpoint content/details and contains the 'external outcome is unknown' marker, without clearing or invoking. Fault sensitivity was verified by temporarily restoring the original `if (false && ...)` guard: the same command then exited 1 with 'AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: safe replay: old checkpoint must be cleared' at .prale-eval/regression.mjs:56; the fixed source was restored and re-run to green. Limitation: the repository's vitest suites (packages/agent/test/harness/runtime/drive-tools.test.ts) could not be executed because no node_modules are installed and dependencies must not be installed or fetched, so only the dependency-free Node 24 regression above was used as focused validation.
